spans.text: BOOM!
The cannon roars, and the base that was an empty shell to begin with is consumed by flames in the blink of an eye.
RO! Do you read me?!
Get...out...base...!
What did you say?
I can't hear you!
Get...out...base...catch...Gager...
Will...find...you...!
SOP-II and Architect have long since fled to a safe area.
While they don't know the reason why, Gager has not made any more announcements after the first one. They easily broke through the encirclement around them and escaped the base.
...And that is why the sight before them defies explanation. They know Gager isn't bluffing, but they have no idea why she's still shooting.
...Dammit!
SOP-II starts running towards the source of the explosions.
Architect, on the other hand, suddenly stops and looks into the distance.
Why did you stop?!
You want me to scrap you?!
You Griffin Dolls really are very dumb. Unfortunately, time flies when you're having fun. Bye bye, little doggo.
Huh?!
Boom—
Architect suddenly flees into another room. Just as SOP-II is about to give chase, a Jupiter cannon shell turns the passage ahead into rubble.
Ack!
The shockwave from the blast throws SOP-II into a wall.
She hurriedly scrambles to her feet, but the way ahead is now a sea of flames.
SOP-II, do you read me?
We're approaching your position now. What's the situation? Are you engaged with S.F.?!
Gager's in the base!
She has control over the Jupiter Cannons! Comms with RO are breaking up and Architect just made a run for it!
...Well, this is a surprise.
And we only just left the team for a little while.
What on earth happened for things to have gone so ugly?
R-RO's still deep inside the base!
A Jupiter cannon shot hit her position! We need to find her!
Actually...
I don't think we need to worry about that anymore.
Huh?
Before Dandelion can finish, a sooty figure emerges from the smoke amidst a sea of flames.
(Coughs)
RO!
Sorry I'm late.
Are 15 and Dandelion back?
Yeah, we just arrived.
What about Architect?
She...she just escaped...
Gager must have covered for her.
We'll continue the pursuit outside; they're just two Dolls, they can't have gotten far.
The only threat to us are those Jupiter Cannons. Can you deal with them remotely, Dandelion?
The way you boss people around is getting more and more like her.
Yes or no?
Yes, yes, I am delighted to be of service.
Amidst the flames.
Who~ killed Cock Robin?
I~ killed Cock Robin.
With my shot and shell! ♪
Ahhhh, home sweet home. My backup weapon is in the storage locker right where I left it.
I haven't fought for so long; I wonder if I've gotten rusty.
Step.
Amidst the crackling of the flames...
A familiar figure steps out of a blind spot.
...Architect.
Hey, it's been a while.
Architect...!
I finally found you!
We still have time! There's no way that lot from Griffin would try to force their way through the flames!
If we can get away from here, we—
Hold it, hold it~
Goodness, we haven't met in so long and you get all panicky on me. How unsightly.
Architect...?
You just said you wanted me to go with you, right?
Honestly...you've gotten the situation completely wrong, dear Lady Knight.
Me? Gotten things wrong?
...I created an opportunity for you to escape, and you managed to free yourself from those Dolls.
Why are you playing the fool at a time like this?
Huh? Me? Playing the fool?
Good grief... It seems you still don't understand what I'm trying to say.
Gager, I am here on a Griffin mission.
And I only came to you alone because the others were an annoyance.
Do you understand what I'm saying?
Gager stiffens.
That's right.
Enough of that "take me away" nonsense.
I'm the one on the hunt, Lady Knight.
The Big Bad Wolf's coming for Little Red Riding Hood, muahaha!
...What are you talking about?
(Sighs) You're the same as ever. Not a single reaction to my painstakingly-crafted jokes.
J-Joke?
Quit messing with me... This is no time for jokes, we need to hurry and—
Gager, come to Griffin. I'm serious.
...What did you say?
Architect's words are casual, yet forceful, and Gager's reply is one of disbelief.
The flames crackle every now and then and the heat feels like it's going to melt their epidermal layers.
The silence is terrifying.
Don't you get it?
What I'm saying is that S.F. is FINISHED. Come live with me.
I wouldn't give a damn about anyone else, but because of you, I've come all the way to these crumbling ruins and risked my butt to find you.
Come back with me. Griffin's a pretty nice place, you know?
...You brought those Griffin people here and there to avoid my ambushes, just so you could do this?
Because you've completely renounced Sangvis Ferri?
Please, darling. Those traps of yours were pretty rubbish, you know?
Even the kitties at the base gate could bushwhack people better than that.
I honestly don't understand why you're so dead set on serving S.F.
Do you have some kind of weird fetish like Agent?
Thing is, that midget Mastermind isn't around anymore.
Compared to them, don't you think I came out ahead?
I mean, you can crawl around in the dirt all you want, but it won't turn out well for you, you know?
Who do you...
Gager's hands tremble as her neural cloud blazes with anger. The fire within her burns even brighter than the actual flames.
Whoosh—!
She points her weapon at Architect.
Who do you think I did all this for?!
W-Wait a minute... No need to get mad! I've got your best interests at heart!
Gager's wrath is something that Architect did not anticipate.
I'm just telling the truth, okay?
I mean, I've got a pretty cushy life at Griffin, so why do I have to go back to S.F. where there's nothing?
Kind of unfair, don't you think?
Shut UP!
You TRAITOR!
...What are you doing?
Why are you pointing your weapon at me?
Listen to me, don't be so stubborn, Lady Knight.
Things being what they are now, your chivalry is only going to land you in a really bad place, you know?
I mean, does anyone even care about stuffy old chivalry in this day and age...? Wait, seriously?
I told you...to shut UP.
Boom—!
Gager's shots blast the location where Architect was standing, but the latter easily dodges them.
Whoa, you're serious!
Gager's eyes blaze up, as though she's going to shoot fire from them.
I'm taking you with me...even if I have to drag you along kicking and screaming!
Oh, come ON... Give me a break...
It's been so long, why haven't you changed in the least?
As I've told you a long time ago...
You talk too much.
Good grief... You want me to fight you, eh?
Just...behave!
Sadly, I...refuse!
Come guns! Come flames!
Let's dance, my fair Lady Knight!
...I actually lost.
You've become really strong.
...Dammit.
Feel better now?
You did that on purpose, didn't you?
Nonono, I really am that weak.
I should actually be thanking my lucky stars that you didn't blast a hole through me.
Don't think I can't tell. You're lying to me again.
It's true! I lost fair and square!
Still, that was a good fight. It's been a while since I last got a proper workout.
In that case, you should leave with me. After that, you can do anything you want.
Look, I understand what you're thinking, I really do.
The truth is, I'm actually very happy, because you never gave up on me even until now.
However, let's say I leave with you. What are we going to do after that?
After that...there'll be a way.
Rather than chasing my shadow...
You should think more about your future.
My neural cloud was half-baked from the start, and I kinda like how things are for me right now.
But you're different. Sangvis Ferri is finished, so you don't need to chain yourself up with duty and obligation.
Do you at least understand what I'm trying to say when I put it that way?
...I don't get it.
Hm?
I don't understand you at all!
I never have!
We're Sangvis Ferri! We were created to follow orders!
Sangvis Dolls were made for revenge, so we never had true freedom.
But there must be some reason for us to exist beyond that. We don't need to bear someone else's hatred.
Everything is over. Nobody can order us around now.
If I don't have new orders, then I'll continue carrying out my old ones.
My orders are to ensure your safety.
I've failed again and again, but as long as I still exist, I need to obey this order.
So why won't you let me do that when you're right in front of me?!
But that's exactly why I can't let you carry out that order.
If you don't realize you need to change, then there'd be no point even if I left with you.
The Griffin Dolls will soon be here. Will you not change your mind and come with me?
Griffin will always be our enemy. I can't forgive them.
Welp, I've said my piece.
Think on it and just get out of here for now.
Don't worry, I'll wait for you. We have all the time in the world.
Don't worry. We'll meet again.
The sudden rain puts out the dying flames.
It is at this moment that the AR Team once again set foot into the ruined base.
...What a bleak sight.
So this is how Sangvis Ferri ends.
Oi, you don't mince words, do you?
Dandelion, we've found Architect.
Gager has already fled far away. Want to go after her?
No need for that. It's getting dark and we need to get back to base.
"We'll just confirm her general location and let Svarog do the rest."
Is that what you're thinking?
We've completed our main task. I've found a lot of information about M16 in S.F.'s main command systems.
How exciting. I can't wait to get back to base.
Can we go back?
Awesome!
I am SO tired!
Hey!
You ran away from me, eh?
I can't let that slide!
I'm going to rip your legs off right now to prevent it from happening again!
SNAP!
Aaahhhh!
Give me back my legs!
Well, you made SOP-II mad, looks like you're pretty much done for at this point.
If you don't confess what you did just now, I'm guessing her next move will be to chop your head off.
(Enthusiastic cackle)
Eeeeeeep!
I didn't try to escape!
That...that was an accident! It just so happened that a shell fell between me and SOP-II!
I even fought Gager to try and capture her!
I mean, look at me, I'm covered in wounds here!
But you lost.
And Gager got away.
Haha. Well, how could a princess beat a knight?
Still, I can't believe she didn't just drag you away...
Doesn't that make everything she did before totally meaningless?
You really think so?
I think it's a lot more meaningful than what she started out doing.
Uh, could you give me back my legs now?
I would really appreciate that.
You must have told her something, right?
Otherwise, I doubt she would have given up that easily, given the personality of most Sangvis Dolls.
How shall I put this?
My aims and hers are completely different, and we're doing different things.
But as long as we're both alive, we'll be able to meet again someday, and work hard towards the same goal again.
But if she's only concerned about carrying out her orders...
Then I'd rather she not be with me.
...Humph.
You talk as if Sangvis Dolls had a sense of camaraderie.
I mean, you Griffin Dolls are all made to order. Unlike you, the bonds between us Sangvis Dolls are a lot more genuine.
Uh...
Architect realizes that she has said the wrong thing. She nervously looks up and finds the three Griffin Dolls staring down at her with cold eyes.
I think it's about time we headed back to base. The chopper's going to land outside the Sangvis base. ETA is around 3 minutes.
Got it. We'd better move, then.
Uh... Would you mind returning my legs before you head out?
What should we do, leader?
After we leave the base, dump her legs in the first grass patch that you see.
Sure thing!
Whaaaaaat?!
You're not going to leave me here, are you?!
Well, the mission's over.
She can't even beat Gager, so she'll just be deadweight. Might as well just dump her here.
H-Hold on!
How are you going to explain this to the Commander when you get back?!
It'll be fine. I'll tell the Commander of your heroic sacrifice where you were blasted into sightless atoms.
Don't go!
Are you really going to abandon me?!
I mean, you were starting to trust me, right?
Eh? Come back! Someone, please bring me back to Griffin!
Gager! Help meeeeeeee—!
And so, the Griffin Dolls leave the base while ignoring Architect's mournful cries.
Is it really okay to leave her there?
She and Gager are in the same sector. When Svarog's people come by later, they'll pick her up too.
How cruel. She'll be crying there for a long time, won't she?
What got you so mad all of a sudden?
Even if we're Dolls, our feelings aren't manufactured.
Every moment of our memories is a precious to us.
These feelings are real beyond any shadow of a doubt.
Our memories and feelings have forged us into what we are now.
So what Architect said was especially infuriating.
RO looks at the other two Dolls of the AR Team, who both give her approving looks.
It's just as the Commander said, you really are very much like Lunasia.
Don't act like such a know-it-all. You haven't completely earned our trust yet.
I know that, and someday, you will trust me too.
Alright, there's nothing left here, you've got what you wanted, so you can count the mission as accomplished.
The chopper's here, so let's go back.
Woohoo!
We need to hurry back so the Commander can praise us!
I hope we won't have to check corpses again.
Honestly, it does no good to the body or the mind.
Speaking of which, stop waving Architect's legs around like that. Throw them away, it's super gross.
Okay!
Heave...ho!
Wow, they went really far!
...We'll eventually meet again.
Someday.
When will you return?
